topics.name: QC Local and External Execution Boundary
topics.purpose: Define explicit local/external QC analysis/execution mode and target scope so code analysis/edit proposals never cross environment boundaries implicitly.

semantics.mode_rule: QC mode is explicit per request/session/profile.
semantics.external_rule: External mode uses exact external endpoint/repository/target binding and applicable remote authority.
semantics.local_rule: Local mode cannot silently dereference remote targets.
semantics.write_rule: QC analysis/result remains inert; code/file changes use explicit candidate diff→validate→authorize→apply.
semantics.authority_rule: Mode selection grants no extra source/write rights.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.
